module.Title: Run Code Only When Allowed
module.Teaching: An if statement runs its block only when the condition inside parentheses is true.
module.PredictionQuestion: When does the code inside an if block run?
PredictionOptions: Only when the condition is false
module.PredictionExplanation: The condition controls whether the block executes.
module.DebugPrompt: An if condition must be placed inside parentheses.
module.RecallPrompt: Write an if statement that adds one stone when canMine is true. Use the exact identifier stoneCount. Use the exact value 1.
module.TransferPrompt: Write an if statement that subtracts 10 health when touchingLava is true. Use the exact identifier playerHealth.
module.PreviewMessage: The game can now make a conditional mining decision.
